definitions.explanation: A cave formed in limestone by the dissolving action of water, typically featuring stalactites and stalagmites. Many such caves in Japan are popular tourist attractions.

examples.japanese: {鍾乳洞|しょうにゅうどう}を{探検|たんけん}する。
{鍾乳洞|しょうにゅうどう}の{中|なか}は{夏|なつ}でも{涼|すず}しい。
examples.english: It's cool inside the limestone cave even in summer.

examples.japanese: {何万年|なんまんねん}もかけて{形成|けいせい}された{鍾乳洞|しょうにゅうどう}の{美|うつく}しさに{感動|かんどう}した。
examples.english: I was moved by the beauty of the limestone cave, formed over tens of thousands of years.

notes: Composed of {鍾乳|しょうにゅう} (stalactite) + {洞|どう} (cave). Famous examples in Japan include {秋芳洞|あきよしどう} (Akiyoshi-do in Yamaguchi), {龍泉洞|りゅうせんどう} (Ryūsen-do in Iwate), and {龍河洞|りゅうがどう} (Ryūga-do in Kochi). Related terms: {鍾乳石|しょうにゅうせき} (stalactite), {石筍|せきじゅん} (stalagmite). The character {鍾|しょう} (to collect, to concentrate) is uncommon outside this word.
